items.description: Exact-line paired audit: 1,243 decided rows, 99 games, 14 dates; champion 50.04%, distribution challenger 50.36%, always Lower 53.82%. Distribution Brier 0.271436 vs 0.272355; no qualified challenger. Posthoc fixed specialist blend: SOG 244/496 vs champion 243/496, always Lower 285/496; Brier improved 0.273384 to 0.271444. No promotion.
Public chronological stats-only replay completed; no original-line hit rate.

135/135 reconstructed OUT rows corroborated against 34 dated official NBA reports; archived row and source hashes verified. Original contemporaneous archive and untouched evaluation still unavailable.

102,900 source-local player-map records, 10,290 maps. Repaired team context yields 17,520 retrospective test observations per market; opponent-adjusted MAE improves kills, deaths and assists. Separate Steam-native headshot cohort is not added to this total. No authoritative cross-provider player link or original-line approval. Independent demo/Kaggle audit: 17 conflicts, 3 single-map candidates, zero authoritative links; 15 token-boundary alias conflicts and one adjacent-date map diagnostic. Regulation-only headshot fixed recent blend MAE 2.361 vs 2.375 over 324 observations; original cohort did not improve. Separate pinned static HLTV export: 21,870 rows, 2,187 complete maps, 423 exact map overlaps, 34 repeated-map identity candidates; no authoritative links.

73,950 map rows with agent, team, opponent and round count; 70,530 opening-kill/death rows and 60,680 patch rows. Agent-conditioned kills MAE 4.10569 vs 4.12247 (12,718 matched); duration challenger not approved. Opponent/team prior round exposure improved MAE 3.0167 to 2.8100 (13,788 observations); conditional on known teams.

200,040 historical source rows; 19,999 complete validated games, 15,623 exact series/game-number bindings, 46,263 Maps 1–2 and 23,289 Maps 1–3 player-series. Team-kill MAE 6.779→6.542; kill share 2.101→2.074; assist share 3.652→3.597. Synthetic calibration worsened; no original prop validation. Advanced historical negative-binomial/Poisson challenger reduced synthetic Brier error across all 12 market/scope groups; no verified original-line or prospective calibration.

3,000 professional matches, 156 dates. Hero-conditioned historical error improved on 3,135 matched observations per market. Prior-only duration blend marginally improved assists MAE 5.535 to 5.520 (4,628); other markets did not improve. Prior team/opponent duration MAE improved 625.74 to 575.99 seconds (4,422).

Separate March 2026 bounded sample: 187 complete maps, 1,496 valid player-map rows across 13 dates. Mode-conditioned kills MAE 5.65 vs last-20 8.59; deaths MAE 5.01 vs 8.26, 388 matched observations per market. Prior cohorts remain separate. June 2026 adds 187 maps / 1,496 rows; mode-conditioned kills MAE 6.315 vs 9.389 and deaths 5.988 vs 9.252 on 480 matched observations each. September returned zero. Cohorts not pooled.
